description: Survivor policy: the timeout ends the hook's own process only. A child it started that ignores TERM is left running.

hooks/hook_pre_parent.sh.body:
#!/bin/sh
(trap '' TERM; exec sleep 3600) &
echo $! > '{root}/child.pid'
echo $$ > '{root}/hook.pid'
exec sleep 3600

expect.log:
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 (hook_pre_parent.sh, timeout 1s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 TIMED OUT after 1s (killed); continuing
expect.errors: [ pfB Hook ] pre #0 TIMED OUT after 1s (killed); continuing
expect.transcript:
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 (hook_pre_parent.sh, timeout 1s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 TIMED OUT after 1s (killed); continuing
